fusions.name: Silk Shot
fusions.desc: Shoots a line of silk that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets, leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and stunned for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Web Line
fusions.desc: Strings a web 4 tiles long for 5 seconds that deals 6 damage to each enemy crossing it. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Spun Lookout
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to spin a lookout that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchor Lines
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (20% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
